args: $files = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.java src | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force bin,lib,../SimpleDBClients/lib | Out-Null; javac -d bin $files; jar --create --file lib/simpledb-engine.jar -C bin .; Copy-Item -Force lib/simpledb-engine.jar ../SimpleDBClients/lib/simpledb-engine.jar

linux.command: mkdir -p bin lib ../SimpleDBClients/lib && find src -name '*.java' -print0 | xargs -0 javac -d bin && jar --create --file lib/simpledb-engine.jar -C bin . && cp lib/simpledb-engine.jar ../SimpleDBClients/lib/simpledb-engine.jar

osx.command: mkdir -p bin lib ../SimpleDBClients/lib && find src -name '*.java' -print0 | xargs -0 javac -d bin && jar --create --file lib/simpledb-engine.jar -C bin . && cp lib/simpledb-engine.jar ../SimpleDBClients/lib/simpledb-engine.jar
